columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: The `core.trials` row this describes.

columns.name: block_id
columns.description: The block this trial falls in. A column rather than a containment join: the join is 2,240x slower at a million trials and needs an operation SQL does not have, and a declared reference gets an anti-join from Tier 1 for free.

columns.name: choice
columns.description: Which spout the animal chose, or `none` where it did not respond. Closed here and not in core: `none` is not a choice, and a foraging task's outcomes are not a two-alternative task's.

columns.name: rewarded
columns.description: Whether the trial delivered reward.

columns.name: iti_duration
columns.description: Inter-trial interval this trial drew, in seconds, from the task's exponential.

columns.name: reward_probability_left
columns.description: Reward probability for the left spout, held constant within a block.

columns.name: reward_probability_right
columns.description: Reward probability for the right spout, held constant within a block.

columns.name: reward_random_number_left
columns.description: The draw compared against `reward_probability_left` to decide baiting.

columns.name: reward_random_number_right
columns.description: The draw compared against `reward_probability_right`.

columns.name: bait_left
columns.description: Whether the left spout was baited.

columns.name: bait_right
columns.description: Whether the right spout was baited.

columns.name: lickspout_position_x
columns.description: Lickspout x position, mm.

columns.name: lickspout_position_y
columns.description: Lickspout y position, mm.

columns.name: lickspout_position_z
columns.description: Lickspout z position, mm.

rules.message: a spout is baited but the trial records no reward probability for it
rules.sql: SELECT session_id, trial_id FROM dynamic_foraging_trials WHERE (bait_left AND reward_probability_left IS NULL) OR (bait_right AND reward_probability_right IS NULL)

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: block_id
columns.description: Stable block ID.

columns.name: block_name
columns.description: What `block_id` stands for (R53 §2.3.1).

columns.name: clock_id
columns.description: Clock for start/stop ticks.

columns.name: start_tick
columns.description: First tick of the block, inclusive, on `clock_id` (R45 §2).

columns.name: stop_tick
columns.description: Last tick of the block, inclusive, on `clock_id` (R45 §2).

columns.name: reward_probability_left
columns.description: The left probability this block holds constant.

columns.name: reward_probability_right
columns.description: The right probability this block holds constant.

rules.sql: SELECT session_id, block_id, start_tick, stop_tick FROM dynamic_foraging_blocks WHERE stop_tick < start_tick

rules.message: blocks overlap, so a trial inside both has no containing block
rules.sql: SELECT a.session_id, a.block_id, b.block_id AS other FROM dynamic_foraging_blocks a JOIN dynamic_foraging_blocks b ON a.session_id = b.session_id AND a.block_id < b.block_id WHERE a.start_tick <= b.stop_tick AND b.start_tick <= a.stop_tick

rules.message: a trial names a block whose interval does not contain it
rules.sql: SELECT t.session_id, t.trial_id, t.block_id FROM dynamic_foraging_trials t JOIN dynamic_foraging_blocks b ON t.session_id = b.session_id AND t.block_id = b.block_id JOIN core_trials c ON c.session_id = t.session_id AND c.trial_id = t.trial_id WHERE c.start_tick < b.start_tick OR c.stop_tick > b.stop_tick
